content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was absent, and the payer’s 30-day retro-authorization window is closed. A necessity appeal has already been attempted, peer-to-peer is unavailable, and similar resubmissions or appeals produced no payment. No contractual patient share was adjudicated, so the authorization-related balance cannot properly be billed to the patient.","action":"write_off"}
